picks.title: The Pentagon Hopes to Speed Up ‘Kill Chain’ AI Buys With 5-Minute Videos
picks.excerpt: The US government’s Tradewinds initiative has made it easier to throw millions of dollars at “nontraditional” defense contractors, including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.
picks.rationale: AI procurement rules: the Pentagon's Tradewinds fast-track (5-minute video pitches) changes how AI vendors including OpenAI, Anthropic and Google sell to defense.

picks.title: Exclusive: Inside Trump's AI science summit
picks.excerpt: President Trump will attend a summit Thursday meant to empower scientists and position the U.S. as a leader in breakthroughs driven by "super intelligence," according to an announcement shared first with Axios. The administration is looking for industry to step in amid cuts to federal science research funding.
picks.rationale: New official announcement: a White House AI science summit that asks industry to fund superintelligence-driven research while federal science budgets are cut.

picks.title: The EU shelved AI liability rules. Sam Altman has revived the debate.
picks.excerpt: OpenAI’s CEO triggers ‘told you so’ moment for fans of liability laws in Europe.
picks.rationale: AI liability is back on the EU agenda after Altman's remarks, reopening a shelved rule that would decide who pays when AI systems cause harm.

picks.title: "I don't want an oligopoly": New open-weight AI models mount a comeback against China
picks.excerpt: A new crop of powerful Western open-weight AI systems from Reflection and Mistral is narrowing China's recent lead, giving businesses and governments alternatives to Chinese open models.
picks.rationale: Covers the US-China AI competition through new releases: Western open-weight models from Reflection and Mistral give governments alternatives to Chinese open models.

picks.title: Europe’s AI policing plan stokes privacy concerns
picks.excerpt: The EU police agency will have to contend with both cybercriminals and privacy activists.
picks.rationale: Europol's plan to expand its AI capabilities brings EU privacy rules into conflict with AI-powered law enforcement.

https://www.axios.com/2026/10/07/exclusi.new_action: White House announced a new presidential AI/superintelligence science summit (Thursday), a separate event from the 9/30 Super Intelligence EO and the 10/05 Kyoto Vision coalition release.
